who.value: buyer watching a TCG live show

stage.value: transaction — Buy Now flash sale during a live show

job.value: Decide whether to buy the item on sale before the timer ends

arrivedFrom.value: A Live shows row, floating Live button or push notification

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The video, the product card with 'S$8900', struck 'S$10,000' and 'Sale 14:59' plus 'Buy now' make the screen's purpose obvious.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'Buy now' button is the most prominent element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Share', 'Shop' and 'More' are clear, but 'Clip' with a scissors icon doesn't say what gets clipped or where it goes.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: '3 left', 'Sale 14:59' and 'See show notes for shipping details' are plain to a shopper.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The buyer decides only whether to buy the shown item at the shown price.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Shipping detail is pushed to 'See show notes for shipping details' and extra actions to 'More'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Chat, follow, share and the sale card all belong to watching and buying in a show.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Price, stock and timer carry the decision; there is no paragraph to read first.
